name: Forma 36
principles: Clarity for people who work in the tool all day. Tokens are public and components consume them.
color: Semantic roles: colorPrimary #0059C8, colorPositive #006D23, colorNegative #BD002A, colorWarning #CC4500, and colorTextDark #111. Base colors, plus gray and black and white, use shades 100 through 900.
typography: Tokens exist for typography. A sans scale for UI, with a monospace for tokens and code. Exact steps are Unconfirmed.
spacing: Tokens exist for spacing, used by stack and flex helpers. Exact steps are Unconfirmed.
shape: Tokens exist for border radius. Exact steps are Unconfirmed.
elevation: Tokens exist for shadows and z-index, used by popovers and modals. Exact steps are Unconfirmed.
layout: Workbench layouts: nav, main canvas, sidebar.
components: Button, form controls, modal, note, and entity list.
adapt: Keep the workbench layout and the rule that components consume tokens. Replace Contentful's blue.
